definitions: Solve two problems with a single action.
examples: I can kill two birds with one stone by dropping the kids off at school on my way to work.
Working from home allows me to kill two birds with one stone: I save on commuting time and can spend more time with my family.
She killed two birds with one stone by studying for her exam while waiting for her appointment.
lemma: kill two birds with one stone
synonyms: hit two targets with one arrow
get two for the price of one
source: kill two birds with one stone
